issue.title: Inspector header can show a finished run as running
issue.body:
The run inspector's header can show a run as still running after the run finished.

**Found by** the WP-F2a (#206) final audit, round 2 (2026-10-23), outside #206's scope, in the existing Edge spec `apps/web/e2e/claude-harness.spec.ts` (the Opus run case near line 162). In one execution the API reported the run as succeeded and the timeline listed `run.finished succeeded`, while the header still read "running at done". A single re-run passed. The test body and the inspector code are not changed by #206; the audit called it an unresolved intermittent failure, not the D-015 native-termination class.

**Likely area:** the inspector header derives the run's status from the run query while the timeline follows the event stream; when the terminal event arrives the header should reflect it (or refetch the run) rather than wait for the next poll.

**Expected:** once the timeline shows a terminal event, the header shows the terminal status. The existing assertion stays as it is; a deterministic test reproduces the ordering (terminal event before the refreshed run record).

Recorded in the I01-I07 delivery register under WP-F2a.
